must_not_own: direct persistence mutations bypassing domain APIs

contract_rules.rule: Identity and authorization are verified at the receiving trust boundary; UI-supplied identity is never authoritative.
Stable canonical IDs are used for ownership and exclusivity; display names and mutable indices are not authority.
Planning is side-effect free; reservation is explicit, durable, idempotent, and recoverable; no partial bundle is exposed as committed.

Runtime lifecycle is behind a backend-neutral interface; callers do not depend on backend-specific process or API details. Runtime IDs accepted by Resource Contract v1 must match the configured inventory runtime IDs.
All tool/agent execution has explicit permissions, correlation IDs, bounded inputs, auditable outcomes, and a dry-run path where applicable.
Memory access is user-scoped, purpose-limited, auditable, and independent from inference backend selection.
Privileged host actions cross one narrow host-agent boundary using allowlisted operations and validated payloads.
Observed state is distinguishable from desired state; unknown or stale observations fail closed for safety-sensitive decisions.
Configuration changes are schema-validated, versioned, and applied through domain APIs with an explicit result.
